notes.title: Major Update version 1.8!
notes.content:
Added single player to Jumpin' Tanks!

Introduced bots to play against in any game mode.

Now you can hold down the space bar to jump!

notes.title: Update Notes for January 14, 2022
notes.content:
Added single player to Jumpin' Tanks!

Introduced bots to play against in any game mode.

Reworked in-app purchases so they will be saved to your Steam account.

notes.title: Version 1.6
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where round wins were sometimes counted twice.
Fixed a bug where you couldn't change your current server without closing the application.
